title: PHP Ledger
author: PHP Ledger
description: Complete double-entry accounting that runs on your own PHP hosting: invoices, expenses, a point-of-sale flow, and a full general ledger with balanced journal entries behind every transaction. This package wraps the published PHP Ledger image (docs/CONTAINER.md) and uses Cloudron's mysql addon as its database instead of the second `db` service compose.production.yaml runs. See NOTES.md in this directory for one contract mismatch that causes.
tagline: Self-hosted double-entry accounting that runs on your own PHP hosting.
postInstallMessage: Open this app's URL and finish setup at /install: PHP Ledger's own browser installer runs there, the same way it does for the ZIP and Composer channels (docs/INSTALLER.md). To install the owner account from the environment instead, edit resources/distribution/cloudron/start.sh to set PL_ADMIN_EMAIL, PL_ADMIN_NAME and PL_ADMIN_PASSWORD before building this package - Cloudron has no per-install operator-variable prompt to collect them at install time.
